From: Alex Torres <atorres@greenlinepay.com>

Cc: security@greenlinepay.com
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor portal: evidence reshuffle & retention window request

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the onboarding session earlier. One quick ask from our side as we prep the SIG/CAIQ bundle: our security team wants to avoid repeated uploads for the next 6 months — is there a way to stage a “reshuffle” in Vendr so we can mark a set of documents as fixed for Q3 and only accept deltas after that?

Concretely:
- We have a backlog of transient artifacts (temp keys, ephemeral logs) that we'd like to rotate regularly, but policy docs (SOC 2 report, encryption policy) should be pinned for 90 days.
- Do you support retention metadata at the artifact level in the portal?
- If not, can you advise a recommended cadence so we can coordinate automated exports instead of manual uploads?

Attaching the list of docs we intend to pin. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Torres
Head of Platform Security
Greenline Payments

(attachment: greenline_pin_list.csv)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <atorres@greenlinepay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal: evidence reshuffle & retention window request

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear ask and for the CSV. Short answer: yes, we can model that, but we need to coordinate between the portal (Vendr/Whistic) settings and an evidence index that tracks "pinned" artifacts vs transient ones.

Plan proposal:
1) We'll upload the static artifacts (SOC 2, encryption policy, dataflow diagrams) and add a retention tag of "pinned:90d" in the portal metadata. That stops automated cleanups and flags them in exports.
2) For transient artifacts (temp keys, ephemeral logs) we will put them under a separate category and configure the portal TTL to 30 days with a scheduled purge.
3) Karthik will propose a small manifest format (CSV column additions) so your automation can call the API to push deltas instead of full bundles.

Next steps: can you confirm which portal you prefer (Vendr or Whistic)? Vendr supports artifact-level metadata tags; Whistic has a bulk-flag flow but it's more manual. If you pick Vendr, we will: 
- Upload the pinned set this week
- Share a preliminary evidence_index_v1.csv for you to review
- Stand up a weekly delta export hook (S3 presign) for Greenline to push changes

I've attached Redwood's SOC 2 scope and a sample evidence index for reference. 

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Security Intake Manager
Redwood Inference

(attachments: redwood_soc2_scope.pdf, evidence_index_v1.csv)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <atorres@greenlinepay.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 14:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal: evidence reshuffle & retention window request

Alex — quick technical clarifications from my side (copied Priya):

- Vendr artifact metadata: we can add two custom fields: retention_days (integer) and pinned (boolean). The portal's API accepts these on upload; we will use pinned=true + retention_days=90 for the documents you want frozen.
- Export hook: we'll create a presigned S3 endpoint where Greenline can PUT delta artifacts. The index CSV should include columns: filename, sha256, retention_days, pinned, artifact_type. Example: encryption_policy.pdf, <sha>, 90, true, policy.
- ACLs: uploads to the presign will be scoped to a short-lived service principal; only Greenline's security team will have write. Redwood will do periodic verification and checksum validation.

I'll draft the minimal manifest and push it to the shared doc. If you'd like, I can also run a 20-minute walkthrough of the presign flow tomorrow.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference
